scope: Installed-native Split sensitivity to cyclic vertex order of identical source faces; shared-kernel comparison, not GUI or public MCP acceptance.

source.construction: Each triangle's three STL vertex records are cyclically rotated once. Face order, geometry, normal records and winding remain unchanged.

native.command: Edit square-source-cyclic > Additional tools > Split Mesh > Split with another body or a mesh > Preview > OK

regression.result: Source permutation and native order-sensitive observation pass; all three exact native comparisons are expected failures. Four passed, three expected failures.

limitations: One cyclic permutation of one manufactured control: the cause may occur during native import, splitting or export; no internal mechanism is proven.
STL does not retain indexed seam identity. Component and hole counts are native GUI observations.
GUI/MCP comparison covers the isolated integrated tree, not the latest M2 branch head or final milestone. Native triangulation remains mismatched.

integratedGuiMcp.result: GUI and public MCP match on the cyclic source and same cutter: 18 facets, two components, areas 1 and 15 mm2, source preservation, undo/redo, binary reopen and held-result cancellation. This does not establish native triangulation parity.
integratedGuiMcp.priorAttempt: r1 stopped at the import assertion because the adapted test still expected original, not cyclic, vertex order; r2 corrected the test input expectation. Both attempts cleaned up.
